title: General provisions
previewText: In the Northern Hunters Point Waterfront Subdistrict, the use, bulk, and parking regulations of the underlying districts shall apply, except as modified by the provisions of Section 117-30 (NORTHERN HUNTERS POINT WATERFRONT SUBDISTRICT), inclusive.
